- A deletion manifest that lists the affected log namespaces and object keys (or equivalent IDs)

- Any KMS/keystore rotation or rekey logs that overlap the deletion window (if applicable)

Can you provide these artifacts or point to the canonical deliverable we should reference in the SIG attestation? We need to attach them to the CAIQ response under "Data Retention and Disposal" and confirm chain-of-custody for auditors.

Appreciate a consolidated packet (attachments or a secure transfer link). If Redwood prefers, we can accept a signed statement plus the raw manifests.

Hi Sofia / Maya,

Following up with the technical deliverables. Attached are the artifacts we generated from the deletion job that ran on 2026-07-14 for tenant microraid-prod-12. Artifacts attached to this message (stubbed):

- segmented-deletion-manifest.csv (columns: object_key, namespace, deletion_timestamp_utc, deletion_job_id)
- proof_of_delete_manifest.json (array of {object_key, storage_delete_record_id, deleted_at_utc, operator_service_id})
- redwood-keystore-rotation-log.txt (rotation entries and key-version mapping around 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-21)

Notes and clarifications:
- The deletion job operates on labeled namespaces. For microraid-prod-12 we removed three namespaces: session-traces, debug-capture/temp and request-debug-evts. Persistent telemetry (aggregates/metrics) was not part of this deletion and remains within the retention SLA.
- Deletions are hard deletes from object store for the listed object_keys; proof_of_delete_manifest.json contains storage-layer delete receipts with request IDs for cross-correlation.
- No keystore rekey was performed as part of this deletion; the rotation log shows a scheduled rotation on 2026-07-20 unrelated to this job.
- For SIG/CAIQ, the manifests contain the object-level evidence auditors want; we can map the manifest fields to CAIQ control IDs if you send the list.

If you want a signed attestation, we can produce a short statement signed by Redwood Security (Marissa) and include a SHA256 digest of the manifest bundle for integrity verification. Delivery options: secure S3 link (preferred), SFTP, or a DocuSign-backed attestation bundle.

Karthik
